justification: CI workflow-only change: removes the CodeQL job (failed on every PR because results upload requires GitHub Advanced Security, unavailable on this private repo) and adds a Semgrep CE job. No application code, no DB queries, no user-facing text touched.
functions: N/A — workflow YAML only, no functions added or changed

break_it.scenario: Semgrep PR scan runs on a branch where origin/<base_ref> is not fetched, so git merge-base fails and BASELINE is empty
break_it.what_happens: semgrep would error on an empty --baseline-commit argument and the job fails loudly rather than silently passing
break_it.repro: Remove fetch-depth: 0 from the checkout step and open a PR — depth-1 checkout lacks the base branch history
break_it.how: Checkout uses fetch-depth: 0 so full history including origin/main is available for merge-base; verified passing on PR #475 itself (42s green run)

break_it.scenario: Pre-existing ERROR-severity findings on main start failing every PR after the swap
break_it.what_happens: Developers would face failures unrelated to their changes, recreating the CodeQL always-red problem
break_it.repro: Run a full semgrep scan on main with the same configs and severity
break_it.how: PR runs use --baseline-commit at the merge-base so only findings introduced by the PR fail; full scans on main/schedule are continue-on-error and report-only

break_it.scenario: Semgrep registry (p/security-audit, p/secrets) is unreachable or pip install semgrep breaks on a future runner image
break_it.what_happens: The job fails on every PR for infrastructure reasons, blocking merges with no security signal
break_it.repro: Network outage to semgrep.dev registry during a CI run
break_it.how: Accepted risk — same exposure class as any third-party CI action; a transient registry outage is fixed by re-running the job

post_merge.db_reset: N/A — no database involvement in this change
post_merge.secrets: None — Semgrep CE runs locally in CI with public registry rulesets, no SEMGREP_APP_TOKEN or other secret required
post_merge.other_repo: N/A — workflow change scoped to this repository only
post_merge.manual_verify: Watch the next scheduled Monday 9am UTC run produces the full-scan summary; confirm the semgrep job appears green on the next unrelated PR
